command:

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('beer_song.go')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''\t\tif n != stop {
\t\t\tverse += "\\n"
\t\t}
\t\tbuilder.WriteString(verse)
'''
new = '''\t\tbuilder.WriteString(verse)
\t\tbuilder.WriteByte('\\n')
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
